name: Fantasista Co.,Ltd.
summary: Fantasista Co., Ltd. is engaged in real estate across Japan, including acquisition, sale, leasing, brokerage and property management. It also handles purchase, sale and administration of securities backed by real estate and receivables, with related consulting, and advises on urban planning and development. Its real estate offerings include the online matching platform Sokugai.jp and the Re:Camp after-sales support service.
